# Get Started with ESM

Welcome! This section will help you choose the right ESM model for your work and get it installed.

## Installation

```bash
# Install the ESM package to access ESM3, ESMC, ESMFold2, ESMFold2-Fast
pip install esm

# Or from GitHub for latest version
pip install git+https://github.com/Biohub/esm.git@main
```
For more details on using the `esm` package, check out our [Github](https://github.com/Biohub/esm).

## Model Overview

Not sure which model to use? Check out the table below and examples below, or for more details, refer to our [Choose Your Model](model-comparison.qmd) guide.

| Model | Purpose | Best For | Input Limit | Speed | Links |
|-------|---------|----------|-------------|-------|-------|
| **ESMC** | Sequence representation | Embeddings, function prediction, fine-tuning | 2,048 aa | Fast | [Model Details](https://biohub.ai/models/esmc) |
| **ESM3** | Multimodal design | Sequence generation, structure prediction | 2,048 aa | Medium | [Model Details](https://biohub.ai/models/esm3)|
| **ESM2** | Sequence representation | Legacy code, established workflows | 2,048 aa | Fast |  |
| **ESMFold** | Structure prediction | Quick structure predictions | Single chain | Very Fast |  |
| **ESMFold2** | Complex prediction | Antibody-antigen, multimers | 768 aa | Fast | [Model Details](https://biohub.ai/models/esmfold2) |
| **ESMFold2-Fast** | Fast structure prediction | High-throughput screening | Single chain | Fastest | [Model Details](https://biohub.ai/models/esmfold2) |

## Models by Use Case

### I need protein sequence embeddings or representations

**Recommended:** ESMC
- Latest foundation protein language model
- Trained on diverse metagenomic protein sequences
- Produces improved protein representations
- Recommended for new projects

**Alternative:** ESM-2 (for legacy compatibility)
- Proven and well documented
- Extensively used in published research
- Best choice when reproducing existing workflows


### I want to design new proteins or generate sequences

**Recommended:** ESM3

- Generates entirely new proteins
- Supports chain-of-thought iterative refinement
- Produces proteins far beyond natural sequence space
- Excellent for:
  - Motif scaffolding
  - Functional protein design
  - Novel protein discovery

**Alternative**

If ESM3 isn't appropriate, use:

- **ESMFold2 + ESMC** for inverse protein design workflows.

### I need to predict protein structure

Choose the model that best fits your application.

**Single protein**

| Goal | Recommended Model |
|------|-------------------|
| Highest accuracy | **ESMFold2** |
| Fastest prediction | **ESMFold2-Fast** |
| Legacy workflows | **ESMFold** |

**Protein complexes**

- Antibody–antigen
- Protein–protein
- Dimers
- Multimers

| Model | Best For |
|--------|----------|
| **ESMFold2** | Highest accuracy and pptimized for very large-scale prediction |
| **ESMFold2-Fast** | Faster high-throughput prediction balancing balance of speed and accuracy |


### I want to fine-tune or train a model

**Recommended:** ESMC

- Modern architecture
- Improved representations
- Designed for downstream model development
- Supports continued pretraining and fine-tuning


### I'm working with legacy code or published research

**Recommended:** ESM-2

- Widely used in the literature
- Stable APIs
- Extensive documentation
- Easy comparison with previous work
